preamble: Fortition of the palatal glide [j] to the voiced postalveolar fricative [ʒ]. Latin word-initial /j/ reached [ʒ] in French (via [dʒ]); Proto-Turkic *y- surfaces as [ʒ] in Kazakh; and in Rioplatense Spanish the merged y/ll phoneme is realized [ʒ] (zheísmo) or devoiced [ʃ] (sheísmo).

examples.note: Latin initial /j/ passed through [dʒ] before simplifying to [ʒ] (modern déjà).
Zheísmo of central and western Argentina; Buenos Aires and Montevideo have devoiced [ʃo] (sheísmo).

sources: Alkire, T., & Rosen, C. (2010). Romance Languages: A Historical Introduction. Cambridge University Press.
